_meta.description: Machine-readable definition of every ReloPass E2E scenario. Each scenario has an ordered step list tagged by role (HR / Employee / Admin), the API call or UI action, the test_id that covers it, the expected outcome, and the DB verification query. The campaign scorer uses this to produce step-level breakdowns instead of binary PASS/BLOCKED.

method_types.API: Automated via relopass_api_runner.js — result already in test_results.json
method_types.UI: Manual browser check using Chrome extension
method_types.DB: Direct database query to verify persistent state
